name: Jayse Hansen — Enochian desktop evaluation
attribution: Project-specific adaptation of a supplied reference; not an official rubric, endorsement or review by the named designer.
scope: Apply cinematic/slide advice to real desktop utility, clarity, material fidelity, hierarchy and motion. Existing user elements and usability requirements take priority over film-specific prescriptions. No fictional data or decorative motion is required for points.

levels.5: The criterion acceptance is verified across relevant views/states with no known material gap.

rules: Use the same evidence and mandatory journeys as the frozen Ryo rubric.
Score twenty criteria 1–5, total 100. All criteria must reach at least 4 and this lens must independently reach 95.
Preserve original Enochian elements; do not redesign controls to imitate the source designer.
Backend-only evidence cannot establish excellent interaction quality. Record evidence methods and uncertain areas.
The Satori 10 architectural layers plus 10 performance criteria are normalized to twenty five-point criteria; slide-only sizes and ratios are adapted to supported application views.
